info.title: Lost and Found API
info.description: API reference for 19 collection operations: Posts, Users, Claims, and Messages. Send JSON request bodies with Content-Type: application/json. IDs are 24-character MongoDB ObjectIds; timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings. Access requirements and current handler limitations are stated on each operation. Response examples illustrate the documented structure; replace example IDs with IDs from your database before sending requests.

tags.name: Posts
tags.description: Browse lost and found posts. Create and manage your own posts.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User profiles and administrator role changes.

tags.description: Submit private ownership proof and review recovery requests.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Private conversations associated with an ownership claim.

get.description: Returns all posts, newest first. Available to everyone. Filtering and pagination are not supported.

example.title: Found a silver ring
example.content: Found near the library entrance. Contact me with identifying details.

post.description: Creates a post owned by the signed-in user. Title and content must contain non-whitespace text. Category defaults to other; status defaults to lost. New posts may be lost or found, never returned.

example.title: Found a silver ring
example.content: Found near the library entrance. Contact me with identifying details.

400.description: Invalid title, content, category, or status.

value.message: Status must be lost or found

get.description: Returns a single post. Available to everyone. A malformed ID currently produces 500 rather than 400.

example.title: Found a silver ring
example.content: Found near the library entrance. Contact me with identifying details.

put.description: Owner only; administrators do not bypass ownership checks. Submit only fields to change. **Current limitation:** changes are not persisted. Supplying a recognized update field currently returns 500; an empty JSON object returns 200 with an empty body. A category-only update is also incorrectly rejected with 400.

200.description: Empty response when an empty JSON object is submitted. No changes are saved by the current handler.

400.description: Invalid post ID or update fields.

403.description: The current user does not own the post.

example.message: Forbidden: This is not your post.

delete.description: Owner only. **Current limitation:** a conflicting ownership check rejects requests from the post owner with 403, so deletion does not currently complete.

patch.description: Owner only. **Current limitation:** the handler accepts open, pending, closed, or archived, which conflict with the Post model's lost, found, or returned values. Accepted values currently return 500. The request schema reflects the current handler; no successful status change is currently available.

example.message: Invalid status. Must be one of: open, pending, closed, archived

403.description: The current user does not own the post.

example.message: Forbidden: This is not your post.

get.description: Administrator only. Returns public profile fields, sorted by createdAt descending. Provider identifiers are excluded. createdAt may be absent because the User model does not currently generate timestamps.
Users may read their own profile; administrators may read any profile. Returns public profile fields without OAuth provider identifiers.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the user profile to retrieve.

403.description: The caller is neither this user nor an administrator.

patch.description: Administrator only. Accepts user or admin. **Current limitation:** valid update requests currently fail with 500 before the target user is loaded. Role changes and the final-administrator safeguard are not currently operational.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the user whose role should change.

example.message: Role must be user or admin

get.description: Post owner or administrator only. Returns private ownership claims, newest first. A malformed ID currently produces 500 rather than 400.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the post whose claims are requested.

example.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

403.description: Only the post owner or an administrator may view these claims.

post.description: Signed-in users may claim another user's post once. Proof is private and must contain 10–1,000 characters after trimming. The current handler permits claims on posts of any status.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the post being claimed.

claim.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

400.description: The post ID or ownership proof is invalid.

errors: "proof" length must be at least 10 characters long

403.description: You cannot claim your own post.

409.description: This user already claimed this post.

get.description: Administrator only. Returns all ownership claims, newest first, including private proof and review details.

example.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

get.description: Claimant, post owner, or administrator only. A malformed ID currently produces 500 rather than 400.

example.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

403.description: The caller cannot access this claim.

404.description: Claim or associated post not found.

put.summary: Update proof on a pending claim
put.description: Claimant or administrator only. Only pending claims can be edited. Proof must contain 10–1,000 characters after trimming. Unknown request fields are rejected. A malformed ID currently produces 500 rather than 400.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the claim whose proof should change.

example.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

400.description: Invalid ownership proof or a claim that is no longer pending.

errors: "proof" length must be at least 10 characters long

value.message: Only pending claims can be updated

403.description: The caller is neither the claimant nor an administrator.

delete.description: Claimant or administrator only. Permanently deletes the claim rather than marking it withdrawn. Any claim status may be deleted; associated messages are not automatically removed. A malformed ID currently produces 500 rather than 400.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the claim to delete.

403.description: The caller is neither the claimant nor an administrator.

patch.summary: Approve or reject a pending claim
patch.description: Post owner or administrator only. Only pending claims may be reviewed. Records the reviewer and review time. Approval does not change the post status. An optional review note must contain 1–1,000 characters after trimming; omit it for no note. Unknown fields are rejected. A malformed ID currently produces 500 rather than 400.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the claim to approve or reject.

example.proof: The inside of the ring has my initials engraved next to a small star.

400.description: Invalid decision, invalid review note, or a claim that is no longer pending.

errors: "reviewNote" is not allowed to be empty

value.message: Only pending claims can be reviewed

403.description: Only the post owner or an administrator may review this claim.

404.description: Claim or associated post not found.

get.description: Intended for the claimant and post owner. Returns up to 100 messages, oldest first, without pagination. **Current limitation:** the participant check is not awaited and can cause an unhandled rejection. This endpoint cannot currently enforce private conversation access reliably.

parameters.name: claimId
parameters.description: ID of the claim associated with the conversation.

example.content: I can provide a photo of the engraving to confirm ownership.

post.summary: Send a message about a claim
post.description: Intended for the claimant and post owner. Content must contain non-whitespace text; its raw length cannot exceed 5,000 characters. The sender comes from the session. **Current limitation:** the participant check fails with 500 for existing claims, so messages cannot currently be created.

parameters.name: claimId
parameters.description: ID of the claim associated with the conversation.

400.description: Invalid claim ID, missing claim, or invalid content. A missing claim currently returns 400 rather than 404.

patch.summary: Mark a received message as read
patch.description: Intended for a conversation participant other than the sender. No request body is needed. **Current limitation:** the participant check fails with 500 for existing claims, so read receipts cannot currently be updated. A missing associated claim returns 403.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: ID of the message to mark as read.

403.description: The message's associated claim was not found.

ServerError.description: Unexpected server or database error. Controller errors use message; the global handler uses error.
